verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch offers only adjacent building blocks. Teams can share and organize request collections in workspaces, search across team content, and self-host the platform. Embeds let you publish interactive mini request consoles in HTML pages. There is no evidence of a dedicated internal API catalog or developer portal, and a community user notes you cannot create documentation for a folder or request. missing for 10: dedicated API catalog/portal publishing, API discovery/registry features, generated API documentation pages, independent corroboration of portal-style use.
